description: This file defines an interface named IClientAddressableTestConsumer within the namespace UnitTests.GrainInterfaces. The interface extends IGrainWithIntegerKey and declares two method signatures: PollProducer returning a Task<int> and Setup returning a Task.

classes.name: IClientAddressableTestConsumer
classes.description: An interface for a client consumer that supports addressable grains with integer keys, including methods for polling and setup.

methods.name: PollProducer
methods.description: Asynchronously polls the producer, returning an integer result.
